book.title: Hibru Quraŋ Moji Hibru yoŋore Quraŋ ruaya.

content: Uŋsowoŋ buŋo tatariine
Maŋkekerisie ogopunoŋuŋ ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe manji jojoko naduŋgaduŋ eku goinebi.

Kotu ŋiŋigo botuŋaŋuŋgo warenimiŋ, yoŋo siŋaŋ yaberu maŋgo eyarebi aŋibaŋi bofukeenimiŋ. Oŋu eiŋgo ore so niga ŋabeeine. Goineji oŋu ebuŋ, oiji Sombuŋ mimerereŋ goine so mane taniŋgaru moko kepore yabebi piyaŋuŋgo gobuŋ.

Goineji witi pigo gogobi, oi manesu yareeinebi. Ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe yoŋoke nigiŋ ŋabebi gonobuŋ, kamasi oi maneru oi manesu yareeinebi. Goine bosembea yabebi ore joiserereŋine manegobi, oi ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe oŋu gonobuŋ, oŋuine maneru manesu yareeinebi.
Ŋiŋigo jikiboti eru boesau egobi Anutuji yoŋo mitari yareiŋ. Ore eru sosowo ŋoŋoji ŋoe ŋonuŋ gogo oi araŋ babi gbagbataeŋine fukeko ŋoe ŋonuŋ botuyakuŋgo kekeroiŋ buŋo wunuŋine mo so eine.

Anutuji iŋoyoŋe buŋo mo iŋi mime pega, “Nonji damaŋ mogo so boke guru ŋadi gubemiŋ.” Buŋo ore eru eeboboŋaŋunji roku roiŋ ore ebu so sase eeinebiyoŋ, ya pe ŋarega, ore eru manebi saga ŋareme jerike goinebi.
Oŋu maneru soine kobinoŋuŋke jogbake dimaku iŋi miku gokimiŋ,

content.text: “Ofonji babapine fukeko moreŋ ŋiŋigoji sibiriga noniminde so oŋu so fukegobi. Ore eru kokoi mo so maneru gogo.”

content: Siŋaŋpuŋaŋunji Anuture buŋo ŋajibuŋ, oi manesu yaberu goinebi. Eeboboyaŋuŋ uruŋu eru babi gogoyaŋunji tariya, oi manesuku mamanesiŋyaŋunde mosi boyoberu goinebi.
Yesu Kristo igokoine tomiri. Rone goya, oi akoŋ muŋambe goga eru damaŋ tatariine tomiri go ropeiŋ.

Yauŋmoriri jikigaru raugabeneŋ maŋnoŋuŋ basanaŋgako fiaeiŋyoŋ, uqo nokiminde mosi oi me oiji maŋnoŋuŋ basanaŋgaiŋgo embimbiŋgaega. Goineji uqore sowo fuŋne fuŋne boyobebi eebobo oiji so yobu bapi yabeko mujugaya. Ore eru goineji sowo furuine furuine ŋiŋigo qaji yareegobi, ŋoŋo buŋo oi bokeinebi. (Mosire buŋoji tiŋtuŋ so eŋareine.)

Boji ririga koro alata fuŋine mo oi noŋunde pega. Moreŋgo kambaŋ seri soriŋ kubainere gio baegobi, yoŋoji boji fuŋine mo ore mobeine roru noiŋgo embimbiŋgaegobi. Anutuji yoŋore buŋo oŋu so mitarime pega.

Moreŋgo soriŋ gio siŋaŋ qoruineji dimaku ŋiŋigo agiburaŋyaŋuŋ keririkeiŋ ore eru joma qaku dariine roru soriŋ kubainere maŋine mokiine yobu oo ropeegayoŋ, joma foriyaŋuŋ oi roru moreŋ kotu gogobi, ore sa sakiineo raru oo rigabi jaku joseŋgaega.
Ore so Yesu oŋuakoŋ kufufuŋpuine iŋoyoŋunde dariji bagbagbaga yabeiŋ ore eru siti sare mendi sakiineo qabi joiserereŋ maneru komeya.
Ore eru kae yayaba
gogobeneŋ, noŋuŋ ore sa sakiineo raru Yesureo jikigainebeneŋ. Iŋore eru igosisi enoreegobi, oi osigaru goinebeneŋ.
Oi yoore eru: Siti tatariine tomiri pe ropeiŋ, oi moreŋgo so pe nobegayoŋ, siti jiki fuke noreiŋ, oi ŋoneiŋgo janjaŋbumbuŋ oderu gogobeneŋ.
Ore eru jijiki Yesuji maŋgo enoreko Anuture mimiteŋ pesiŋ eru goinebeneŋ. Yesure tina miteŋ gaegobi, yoŋore mi bibire foriji Anuture pesiŋ fukega.
Ya pe ŋarega, oi boroiŋgaru bobiaŋ naduŋgaduŋ eegobi, oiji Anuture pesiŋ mo fukega. Anutuji pesiŋ oi ŋoneko maŋineji fiame sagaega. Ore eru oŋu enimiŋ ore so niga ŋabeine.

Siŋaŋpuŋaŋunde buŋo reŋgaru usuŋyaŋunde rurumaŋgo raru goinebi. Gio babuŋ ore ropuyaŋuŋ Anuture jiŋoo ruanimiŋ, yoŋo ore so ŋone ŋaberu maŋ-ŋaŋuŋ siŋaŋ gaegobi. Yoŋoji gioyaŋuŋ oi maŋyobiŋ paio egu banimiŋ. Oiji ŋoŋo so babi ŋabena. Ore eru buŋoyaŋunde rurumaŋgo raru gobi jeri paio gioyaŋuŋ babi sagaiŋ.
Ŋoŋo niŋore eru Anutu oŋga wosieinebi. Ya sosowo oo eebobo tinabiŋeineke ekiminde aŋi pe noreko Anutuji ŋone noberu “Sagaga,” miko maŋkajenoŋunji manebeneŋ fiaega. Buŋo oi mane mukugobeneŋ.
Nonde oŋga wosieinebi ore yameŋ keku yoore eru bapakare ŋabego: Ŋoŋo oŋga wosibi Anutuji damaŋ so bojoroko fiaru soine moke ŋoŋoreo warebemiŋ.
Iŋi oŋga wosiego.

Yesuji komeya ore eru lama siŋaŋ tinabiŋeineke fukeru goga. Dariine keseru ore mogeineji Anuture jojofo buru qakatoru basanaŋgame damaŋ tatariine tomiri pe ropeiŋ. Anutuji Ofoŋnoŋuŋ iŋo bogboreme komegone pakereru sanaŋgaru goga.

Anutu womo Rauineji dobe ŋaberu maŋ aŋiinere so eba eku goniminde kuriri sosowo ŋareeiŋ. Oŋu soine sanaŋgaru gio fiine fuŋne fuŋne baku goinebi. Iŋoji roosoe ŋaberu bapakare ŋabeko Yesu Kristoreo kitiŋgaku gogo Anutureo sagaga, oŋuine goinebi. Kristore tinabiŋe damaŋ so miteŋ gabeneŋ damaŋ tatariine tomiri kuririineke pe ropeiŋ. Buŋo oi foriine.
Buŋo tatariine
O maŋkekerisie ogopune, nonji iŋi weu ŋarego: Biŋe Quraŋ pompoŋine yo quraŋga ŋarego. Ore eru uŋsowoŋ buŋone yo yameŋ keku raugainebi.
Biŋe yo maneniŋ: Maŋkekerisie ogonoŋuŋ Timoti iŋo witi pigone piruebi wakiya. Pipa yoo wapeiŋ ine, noŋ iŋoke wareru ŋone ŋabenimi.
Momojo buŋo ruabe siŋaŋpuŋaŋuŋ sosowo eru Anuture ŋiŋigo gbagbataeŋine sosowo yoŋo yajiinebi. Itali ogopunoŋunji momojoyaŋuŋ ruabi ŋoŋoreo foga.
Anuture yauŋmoririji sosowo ŋoŋoke pe roperu peine.

footnotes.text: 13.13 Moreŋgo damaŋ pompoŋine gogobeneŋ, ore tinaine yayaba.
